Questions.QuestionText: Which Charles Dickens novel features the characters Pip, Magwitch and Estella?
Questions.AnswerFact: Published in 1861, Great Expectations is the 13th novel by English author Charles Dickens, and is his penultimate completed novel.

Questions.QuestionText: What was the first Agatha Christie novel to feature the character Hercule Poirot?
Questions.AnswerD: The Mystery of the Blue Train
Questions.AnswerFact: Written in 1916 and published in 1920, The Mysterious Affair at Styles is the first detective novel by British writer Agatha Christie, introducing her fictional detective Hercule Poirot.

Questions.QuestionText: Which children's author wrote The Tale of Squirrel Nutkin?
Questions.AnswerFact: Written and illustrated by Beatrix Potter, The Tale of Squirrel Nutkin is a children's story about a red squirrel named Nutkin. It was published in 1903, by Frederick Warne & Co.

Questions.QuestionText: As of 2025, which is the best-selling book series of all time?
Questions.AnswerA: A Song of Ice and Fire
Questions.AnswerFact: The Harry Potter series has sold over 600 million copies, making it the best-selling book series of all time. Goosebumps is the second best-selling book series of all time, with over 400 million copies. Nancy Drew has sold over 200 million, and A Song of Ice and Fire over 90 million.
